actionConfiguration.body:
SELECT
    p.id AS productId,
    p.code AS productCode,
    p.name AS productName,
    p.barcode AS barcode,
    p.sku AS sku,

    u.id AS unitId,
    u.code AS unitCode,

    tr.id AS taxRateId,
    COALESCE(tr.rate, 0) AS taxRate,

    COALESCE(NULLIF(p.sale_price, 0), price.salesPrice, 0) AS unitPrice,
    COALESCE(stock.availableStock, 0) AS availableStock,
    COALESCE(p.track_stock, 1) AS trackStock

FROM products p

LEFT JOIN units_of_measure u ON u.id = p.unit_id
LEFT JOIN tax_rates tr ON tr.id = p.tax_rate_id

LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        pp.product_id,
        MAX(COALESCE(pp.price, 0)) AS salesPrice
    FROM product_prices pp
    WHERE pp.price_type = 'SALE'
      AND pp.valid_from <= CURDATE()
      AND COALESCE(pp.valid_to, '2999-12-31') >= CURDATE()
    GROUP BY pp.product_id
) price ON price.product_id = p.id

LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        sm.product_id,
        SUM(COALESCE(sm.quantity, 0)) AS availableStock
    FROM stock_movements sm
    WHERE sm.warehouse_id = {{ Number(this.params.warehouseId || QuoteWarehouseSelect.selectedOptionValue || appsmith.store.warehouseId || 0) }}
    GROUP BY sm.product_id
) stock ON stock.product_id = p.id

WHERE p.company_id = {{ Number(appsmith.store.companyId || 0) }}
  AND COALESCE(p.is_active, 1) = 1
  AND (
      p.barcode = {{ this.params.lookup || "" }}
      OR p.code = {{ this.params.lookup || "" }}
      OR p.sku = {{ this.params.lookup || "" }}
      OR p.name LIKE CONCAT('%', {{ this.params.lookup || "" }}, '%')
  )

ORDER BY
    CASE
      WHEN p.barcode = {{ this.params.lookup || "" }} THEN 1
      WHEN p.code = {{ this.params.lookup || "" }} THEN 2
      WHEN p.sku = {{ this.params.lookup || "" }} THEN 3
      ELSE 4
    END,
    p.code

LIMIT 1;
